# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_CONFIRM_BEAR_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volume confirmation filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entry trigger will reduce false breakdown signals. A breakdown bar with elevated volume (>1.5x 20-bar average) indicates stronger institutional participation, improving the edge of the setup.

## Mechanism

The existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger requires ≥2 of: (1) level rejection, (2) EMA ribbon flip bearish, (3) confluence with multi-day/premarket structure. We add a fourth condition: the breakdown bar's volume must be >1.5 × the average volume of the prior 20 bars. All other context filters (time, VIX, ribbon spread, etc.) remain unchanged. Entry occurs on the next bar open when all conditions are satisfied.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed filter will be evaluated on the full 16-month OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Sample size is all BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger events (~200). Overfit risk is moderate; we are adding a single volume threshold that could be optimized in-sample.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill validation not yet performed)  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: filter may reject all entries on a low-volume breakdown day, turning a potential winner into a skip. Max drawdown scenario: if the filter mistimes entries during a choppy regime, repeated small losses could accumulate. Blow-up scenario: none (filter only reduces trade frequency, does not increase risk per trade).  
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
